pages.title: Crops
pages.text: I watched the wheat for a long time. It did not stretch a little at a time: the whole plant changed at once. Growth climbed invisible steps until the ears were ripe.

pages.title: Putting It to Work
pages.text: The device follows those changes backward, returning nearby $(l)mature crops to seedlings$() and reclaiming part of their aether. The plant remains, but there is no harvest.
